::: {.page-intro}
I am an **AI Engineer and emerging researcher** with a background in applied machine learning, computer vision, retrieval systems, and research. I currently work at **Griphic** on applied AI systems, while continuing to develop my research interests through experiments, paper reproduction, and technical writing.
:::

## Current Focus

My strongest technical thread combines **computer vision**, **retrieval**, and **representation learning**. I am currently exploring visual and geometric retrieval, robust perception, and multimodal or vision-language representations as research directions rather than treating them as established specializations.

Some of my strongest current professional work is confidential, so I describe it publicly only at a level that respects those boundaries. I prefer public claims that can be supported by code, experiments, publications, or other inspectable evidence.
